description: Use this when the user asks where a card is and a picture helps: shows each matching card with its image, every stack (how many, in which place, which printing) and the decks that claim it. Reads the same data as where_is and changes nothing. The result is also your answer in words: say the place first; name every deck on a stack whose claim is `shared`; say when a stack `is_proxy`. `more_cards` counts matches not shown.
